carriers.name: Viettel Telecom
carriers.recommendation_reason: Mandatory for mountain travel (Ha Giang Loop, Sa Pa, Cao Bang) and island cruises (Ha Long, Phu Quoc). Operates the largest nationwide standalone 5G core network.
troubleshooting: Ensure Data Roaming is turned ON in Cellular settings.
If APN is blank, create new APN with Name 'Viettel' and APN 'v-internet'.
Toggle Airplane mode for 10 seconds to force attach to the nearest BTS.

carriers.name: Vinaphone (VNPT)
carriers.recommendation_reason: Strong in major metropolitan centers (Hanoi, HCMC, Da Nang). Coverage drops in deep Northern mountain passes.

carriers.name: MobiFone
carriers.recommendation_reason: Good urban coverage, frequent dead zones on rural highways.
